result.title: Calibrated Functional Prediction from Overlapping Nonlinear Observations
result.summary: We study prediction of nonlinear audit functionals from scalar observations of a shared hidden table state. For Schur-rational operators, local Gaussian projections yield a common sparse kernel for overlapping tasks, repeated row identities, and cross-row dependence. Shared-state residual samples extend this kernel through a positive-semidefinite feature representation. Positive matrix integration and sample-value enclosures connect the original inputs to the actual saved hybrid prediction. A sorted calibration-role perturbation bound then certifies its complete finite-pool pinball risk. Independent complete-loss selection chooses the ridge, score scale, and residual weight, while task-rank calibration supplies an upper endpoint. Evaluation uses twenty new reference contexts per dataset at two task sizes, giving 400 conditions across ten benchmark populations. The mean dataset complete-loss ratios are 0.9977 to the degree-two kernel, 0.9961 to matched complete-MC shrinkage, and 0.9911 to the retrospective minimum over 174 public configurations. The last ratio has a paired reference-bootstrap interval of [0.9898,0.9927]. On 40 profiles at coefficient tolerance $10^{-7}$, Gamma quadrature has a geometric mean cold-time ratio of .0646 to strengthened Arb/Petras integration.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究在共享隐藏表状态的标量观测下，对非线性审计泛函进行校准预测，提出基于 Schur 有理算子、局部高斯投影的稀疏核、残差特征表示与矩阵积分/风险界定，并用独立完全损失选择与四分位校准给出有限池 pinball 风险证书。
AI.relevance_reason: 内容属统计估计与数值积分（核构造、风险界定、求积效率）方法，「隐藏状态」「校准」等词仅为术语相似，与 VLM 的 latent 状态生成、视觉证据使用或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策无具体可借鉴线索，故排除。
